partial_generation_telemetry.scope: Observed in-process total query wall time on a shared development host; includes resource waits and same-run resumability effects. Not HTTP end-to-end latency or a production SLA.

logged_timeout_evidence.caveat: Empty completed-response telemetry is not on its own proof of an attempted HTTP call; timeout classification additionally uses the recorded evaluator warning and timed stage.

http_timeout_rate.reason: Completed-response usage and saved question rows do not enumerate every attempted HTTP request. Logged timeout evidence is reported separately.

partial_generation_telemetry.wrapper_counter_note: generation_model_calls and verification_model_calls count wrapper invocations, not actual HTTP requests. Numeric guards may return before HTTP; usage proves completed responses only.

confidence_note: Selected metrics only. Frozen percentile bootstrap, 5,000 draws, seed741; repeated runs cluster by question/probe ID. Degenerate intervals and small synthetic samples do not establish population guarantees. Prefix CIs are conditional on the stopped prefix, not representative multimodal accuracy.
not_measured: External RAGAS LLM-judge metrics and exact semantic context precision/recall: NOT MEASURED. Separate bounded Codex review covers 43 saved answers.
Full generation final pair, cross-run final variance and three-pass consistency: stopped by user budget.
Final RAGAS embedding similarity/BERTScore: reference postprocessing was not reached.
Scanned-PDF generation quality: no scanned questions in the stopped prefix.
HTTP timeout rate, production capacity/cost, numeric trust calibration and isolated3D FPS: not established.

independent_review.method: Mechanical aggregation of three existing independent Codex review artifacts; this aggregator does not rejudge or rescore any answer.

reviewer_provenance.reviewer: Three Codex review assignments, one reviewer per text, table, or image/chart partition
reviewer_provenance.judge_model_id_reason: Exact serving model identifier was not exposed in the review artifacts.

coverage.sampling: Deterministic 43/60 stopped prefix; not randomly sampled. One incomplete run; no scanned generation, second final run, or third-pass consistency sample.
coverage.per_modality_mean_weights: Overall means weight applicable question rows equally; they do not average modality means.

definitions.answer_correctness: Existing 0/0.5/1 rubric. Answerable-only weighted mean is primary; correct negative abstentions are reported separately. A score of 0.5 is partial credit, not a fully correct answer.
definitions.nulls: Null score values are excluded from means and explicitly counted. Faithfulness excludes 7 no-substantive-answer refusals; relevancy excludes 6 appropriate authored-negative abstentions.
definitions.false_refusal: Saved generation metrics.abstained is true AND authored unanswerable is false. Judge abstention_appropriate=false is not itself a refusal; table reviewers also used it for correctly answered positives.
definitions.hallucination: Existing reviewer explicit unsupported factual-claim flag. Report all-row, answerable, and substantive-answer denominators; a false refusal is not a fabricated fact.
definitions.citation_support: Existing supported/partial/unsupported/none category per answer; no fabricated claim counts or numeric partial weights. Claim-count citation precision and recall remain NOT MEASURED.

citation_claim_support_per_response.definition: Categorical per-response judgment, not a counted-claim precision/recall metric; partial is not assigned a numeric weight.

not_measured: Exact semantic context precision@5 and context recall: contexts were not independently scored as complete ranked sets.
Claim-count citation precision/recall: judgments are categorical per answer, without claim enumeration.
External RAGAS LLM-judge scores: no external judge call or credential; these separately named Codex review scores do not fill frozen RAGAS fields.
Scanned-PDF generation quality: zero saved generation responses; scanned ingestion metrics remain a separate scope.
Population/production accuracy, repeat-run stability, inter-rater agreement, and statistical confidence for this review.
limitations: Fictional authored PDFs and non-random incomplete coverage; 43/60 is not a full multimodal benchmark.
Text review used saved excerpts/references; table and visual reviews also inspected source PDF pages. Original pages may contain evidence absent from the exact OCR quote.
Different reviewer partitions are not multiple ratings of the same answers; no inter-rater calibration or human expert adjudication.
Faithfulness can be high for a relevant-source quotation that still fails to answer the question; visual failure IDs must be read alongside correctness and relevancy.
No matched-subset independent baseline review exists, so this review does not establish semantic improvement over baseline.
